analyst_note: All refuted findings are either about different programs (ovarian cancer biomarkers and brenetafusp vs. the melanoma tebentafusp catalyst) or constitute minor operational/promotional issues that do not indicate data masking. The timeline guidance inconsistencies—repeatedly stating 2H 2026 readout while CT.gov showed 2028-03 primary completion—reflect aggressive investor guidance rather than concealment of trial failure, especially given the catalyst has now arrived. The cross-trial benchmark comparisons involve early Phase 1/2 supportive data, which is standard biotech promotion when a randomized pivotal is the actual basis for the catalyst. No company-level dishonesty findings (no fraud settlements, retractions, or misconduct). No material manipulation of the catalyst trial's endpoints, enrollment, or efficacy claims detected.
